verdict.rationale: Otter documents an Android app that can "record, transcribe, and access your meetings on the go," and a community user confirms recording through the iOS app. Separately, Otter documents searching transcripts across all time periods and AI Chat search across meetings, but no evidence explicitly says mobile recordings of in-person conversations land in that same searchable workspace. missing for 10: explicit documentation that mobile-captured in-person recordings sync into the same searchable workspace/Channels, explicit in-person (non-call) capture wording, first-party iOS app documentation, independent corroboration of mobile-to-workspace search.

support.subject: As a founder, I can record and transcribe in-person conversations from a mobile app, and those notes land in the same searchable workspace

citations.quote: Record, transcribe, and access your meetings on the go with the Otter Android app
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps
Meetings grouped by team, project, or topic so everyone can find recordings and collaborate in one shared space.
